steps.content: You walk across the pink beach as the sun sets. Roulecca's clover father leads you into a seaside villa.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Please wait while I go tuck in Roulecca. You may do as you wish for the time being.
He carries the sleeping Roulecca upstairs, leaving you in the first floor lobby. The other four-leaf clovers around are doing chores in silence, as if they don't care about your presence.
